answer: In this economy, rewards are carved in marble: they vest slowly, a few grains released each dawn, and only to identities that keep paying a small daily upkeep of verified work. A lone honest agent finds this cheap. A sybil farmer running ten thousand puppets must feed every fake its upkeep every single day while detectors hunt them; like saffron, the yield comes a few precious threads at a time, and most puppets are pruned long before their first coin ever unlocks.
